svg.text: Shared gene, class I Gln amidotransferase (217220)
Grain free amino acid GWAS, 280 inbreds, 71 traits
Free pool dominated by Asn and Pro
IC free AA and Pro up, Asp and Glu down
How to read the gene marks
IC or J is printed after marks at the IC / J corner.
Shared Asp and Pro QTL on chr 3
Genes are positional candidates, within 25 kb of a significant GWAS SNP or in a top-5% FST window. Numbers are Zm00001eb gene IDs (B73 RefGen_v5).
Shaded box, the CornCyc L-homoserine biosynthesis pathway, the only pathway with a candidate in all four gene sets and the top-ranked pathway in the recurrence test.
Thick arrows, L-homoserine biosynthesis. Dashed arrows, amide N from Gln to Asn, and the ω-amidase route returning Asn carbon to oxaloacetate. Grey, context not found in any analysis.
